purpose: Freeze planner-independent comparison structure before formal planner benchmarking. Numeric world-model ranges, budget grid, action granularity, and reward remain OPEN until simulator criticism and cross-team review.

train.note: Policy optimization only; not used for formal reporting.

validation.note: Fresh seeds/parameter draws from train families.

id_test.note: Frozen formal in-distribution evaluation seeds; no hyperparameter tuning.

ood_parameter_test.note: Parameter shifts outside final train ranges; exact shifts OPEN pending R5 criticism.

ood_topology_test.note: Graph-size/topology shifts; exact cases OPEN pending graph/evaluation freeze.

comparison_rules: Same incident cases, seeds, budget, observable information and constraints for every planner.
Planner never receives HiddenWorld or synthetic occupancy truth.
Information Gain is the strong competitive baseline; Frontier is the interpretable fallback baseline.
Do not retune simulator families after seeing which planner wins.
Reward weights, if used by RL, are not the same object as primary evaluation metrics.
Report mean plus dispersion/confidence interval and visible failure cases, not winner-only averages.
open_before_final_freeze: numeric world-model parameter ranges after simulator criticism
q support/range from defensible external evidence plus sensitivity
number of formal cases per split
claim_guardrail: Benchmark results support only performance on the formalized synthetic task and robustness to tested simulator assumptions. Historical replay supports retrospective plausibility only.
